title: Specterite Armor Models and Other Extensions
description: Adds extensions to my other resource pack "Specterite", such as changing all (most) instances of the word "Netherite" to "Specterite" and changing the armor model.
body:
Adds extensions to my other resource pack "Specterite", such as:
-Replacing almost all instances of the word "Netherite" with "Specterite"
-Changing the armor model of netherite armor to specterite armor

Make sure to use this with my other texture pack "Specterite" or else it will be very weird.
Link to Specterite: [Specterite](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/specterite)

**MAKE SURE TO PUT THIS PACK ABOVE SPECTERITE**
